historical_record.description: Fire Station 34, then almost 70 years old, closed in June 1996 for a renovation paid for by the 1992 fire bond: seismic work, disabled access and separate quarters for men and women. It was expected to reopen in August 1997.

In 1969 the firehouse here, built in 1928, was Fire Station 47, home to Engine 47. It had two storeys, two apparatus bays and a ground floor of 2,500 sq ft; the city's fire-station study that year called its dormitory cramped and its condition fair.
